complete_new_question_objects.question: Bringer uses Tsunami with its threshold. Its base Damage would destroy a Town, so that Town is Pushed into an adjacent other Coastal land on the same board. Tsunami’s threshold later deals Damage in that land. Counting only nightmare-destruction Fear from that same Town, can it produce that Fear again during this single Tsunami use, or only once?

complete_new_key_objects.answer: Only once. Moving the same Town into another land affected later by this Tsunami does not reset the single-Power, single-Invader limit.

required_facts: Explorer pretend-destruction gives 0 Fear and allows Push.
Town gives 2 Fear and allows Push.
City gives 5 Fear and no Push.
No actual destruction means no Mists destruction-based bonus or Vengeance trigger from those pretend deaths.

new_primary_source_refs.transcribed_passage: Tsunami. Cost6; Slow; Range2 from Sacred Site; target Coastal. 2 Fear. 8 Damage. Destroy2 Dahan. IF YOU HAVE 3 Water 2 Earth: In each other Coastal land on the same board: 1 Fear, 4 Damage, and Destroy1 Dahan. Printed Elements: Water, Earth. No expansion set emblem is printed on the face.

new_primary_source_refs.label: Native printed source
new_primary_source_refs.transcribed_passage: TO DREAM A THOUSAND DEATHS. Your Powers never cause Damage, nor can they Destroy anything other than your own Presence. When a Power of yours would Destroy (or deal enough Damage to Destroy) Explorer/Town/City, generate0/2/5 Fear instead. The Power Pushes all Explorers/Towns it would Destroy. Notes: A single Power cannot Destroy a given Invader more than once. Powers which cause Damage via Dahan are affected just like all others. All effects other than Damage/Destroy work as usual.
